limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter’s combinational feedback but also removed the existing `ready_b` condition, changing `data_out` from adding to the previous value to starting a fresh sum when a group’s first input is accepted while `ready_b` is low.

The passing scoreboard unconditionally cleared its sum after each group, so it exercised backpressure but expected the agent’s new behavior rather than checking that the original `ready_b`-dependent accumulation was preserved.
